title: California approves $42M to protect Wild Cherry Canyon
summary_full: California has taken a major step in environmental conservation by approving a new grant for the Wild Cherry Canyon project. Spanning 2,060 acres, this coastal area will be safeguarded from any development and transformed into a nature preserve. With a focus on habitat restoration and community engagement, tribal communities will partner in maintaining this valuable ecological site, welcoming visitors to enjoy its natural beauty.
